d: Cyclone Arnab’s aftermath has left parts of Odisha battling severe floods, with villages and farmlands submerged across Ganjam and Gajapati districts. Over 62,500 people have been affected, prompting rescue operations, including helicopter evacuations. Train services have also been disrupted, with nine trains cancelled and 14 diverted. In Andhra Pradesh, crop damage has been reported, with seven people feared dead as authorities assess the impact.
